name: Cyber Security Cloud,Inc.
summary: Cyber Security Cloud, Inc. develops AI-driven web security solutions in Japan. Its offerings include Shadankun, a web security service that detects and blocks cyber-attacks on websites and servers, WafCharm, an automated platform that uses AI to manage AWS WAF rules, and managed rules for AWS WAF. It also researches cyber-attacks and AI technology. Dating from 2010, it has its headquarters in Tokyo.
